sections.title: Eligibility and preparation
sections.text:
Eligibility for your route [Standing rule]
Eligible in principle with the UChicago bachelor’s completed before enrollment; no prior master’s required.
Mathematics offers a PhD, not a terminal master’s. International students may apply. TGS currently restricts
applications from persons located in or ordinarily resident in specified comprehensively sanctioned regions;
citizenship alone is not the published test. F-1 status alone does not settle that question. [requirements] [intl]
[math]
Before submission [Standing rule]
Use the TGS New Student application; only one TGS program per year. Prepare two essays, academic records
and the detailed mathematics-course list. Ask professors before entering requests. If seeking the limited
international fee waiver, upload both essays and transcript FIRST, then email
math-gradadm@northwestern.edu; the recommended October 31 contact date has passed. Request English
waiver through Mathematics after submission. [requirements] [math] [letters] [intl]
Adviser contact [Standing rule]
No pre-application supervisor agreement is required in the published checklist. Research questions/faculty fit
belong in the Academic Statement. Faculty below are current research leads; availability to supervise 2027
entrants is unconfirmed. Antieau is on leave at Resolution; Francis is at SLMath in Fall 2026. Check these
arrangements before relying on a match. [math] [essays] [roster]
Portal workflow [Standing rule]
CollegeNET/ApplyWeb; only one TGS application per academic year. Once submitted, the main application
cannot be changed; pay or secure fee waiver before it is complete. Track references/test scores and decision
through dashboard, and record final enrollment by offer-letter date. Do not send extra material directly to Math
without first contacting graduate admissions. [requirements] [portal] [decision] [math]
Cycle verification [2027 confirmed]
Department explicitly states September 2027 GRE policy; TGS explicitly opened 2026-27 applications
September 15, 2026. December 31 date is standing/contextual, without printed year or time zone. Dollar
amount currently published is for 2026-27, not Fall 2027 entrants. [math] [dates] [fund]

documentation. Do not mistake this admission waiver for TA-language clearance; Math requires spoken-English
qualification by the start of year two. [math] [intl] [faq] [taenglish]

Transcripts and degree records [Standing rule]
Upload legible PDF transcripts from all colleges attended, including current and nondegree study. TGS FAQ
permits omitting a separate record when course titles AND grades appear on another included transcript.
Unofficial records suffice; official copies sent before an offer are discarded. Non-English records need a neutral
third-party English translation. International credentials additionally need conferred-degree certificates where
applicable. Final official degree/conferral evidence is required after accepting. [transcript] [faq] [intl] [math]
Mathematics-course list [Standing rule]
Required list of junior-, senior-, and graduate-level mathematics courses already taken or expected before
entry, with textbook (if any) and brief topics for EACH course. For a UChicago applicant, distinguish
completed/current/planned courses; no public template or length cap found. [math]
Course descriptions [Standing rule]

syllabi or full course-description uploads are not explicitly requested. [math]

Number and type [Standing rule]
Minimum three, maximum four; professors familiar with advanced mathematical work, preferably experienced
in PhD advising. Strong advice: no more than one REU letter. This supersedes the TGS general minimum of
two. [math] [letters]
Scholarship references [Standing rule]
No additional incoming funding reference is specified. Later Presidential Fellowship requires two distinct
faculty/program letters: scholarship/research potential and contribution to the Society of Fellows, plus the
program’s comparative endorsement. It is limited to existing years 2-5 students and is unavailable to this
incoming applicant in 2027. [math] [presidential]
What sends the invitation [Standing rule]
The vendor says clicking Submit the Request sends invitations; merely typing details is not the documented
trigger. Current Northwestern FAQ confirms editing a referee email sends a new invitation. Exact current
Math-screen button placement was not inspected. [trigger] [faq]
Before versus after submission [Standing rule]
ApplyWeb supports requests and completed letters before the application is submitted (confirmed by its
pre-submission revision workflow). Thus invitations are not inherently held until final submission. Confirm the
Math form’s request controls; do not wait until December 31. [trigger] [revise]

Yes: TGS describes a dashboard with letter status; ApplyWeb marks successfully submitted online letters
Completed in real time. Letters match automatically. An exceptional department-approved emailed letter may
not appear in the vendor status; confirm with admissions. [portal] [receipt] [faq]
Updating and reusing letters [Standing rule]
Referee name/email can be edited until the referee starts; a started form needs support reset. Editing email
sends a replacement invitation. Vendor permits the referee to revise a submitted letter until the APPLICATION
is submitted; later revisions require vendor support and are not guaranteed review. Math acceptance of

Statement of purpose [Standing rule]
Required Academic Statement upload, 500-1,000 words (maximum 1,000). Prompt paraphrase: academic
interests and reasons for this program; preparation through education, work, research or training;

Required separate Personal Statement upload, 125-250 words (maximum 250), not duplicating the Academic
Statement. Prompt paraphrase: choose relevant formative experiences/opportunities/challenges; leadership,

Exact original prompts are at the source. No public font/spacing rule found. [essays]

Required within the Academic Statement: questions of interest and aligned faculty. No separate

sections.title: Funding and fees
sections.text:
Amount and coverage [Prior cycle]
Published university-wide 2026-27 minimum: USD 47,748 per year, four quarters/year (12 months), before tax;
not a confirmed 2027-28 Mathematics offer. Funding covers tuition, health-services fees and annual
health-insurance premium; activity and other uncovered fees remain student expenses. Individual
mathematics amount and 2027-28 increase require offer confirmation. [fund] [fundfaq] [fundmodel]

Years of support [Standing rule]
Typical support is five years, including four-quarter/year funding; mathematics first and fifth years are
fellowships, other years generally TA support. Renewal requires satisfactory progress. External support may
bank up to four quarters toward a possible sixth year; this is conditional, not a universal sixth-year guarantee.
[welcome] [handbook] [fundmodel]
International eligibility [Standing rule]
TGS explicitly says international students generally receive the same funding as domestic students. TA funding
requires separate spoken-English qualification; degree-based admission waiver does not remove it.
Federal/external awards have award-specific citizenship rules. [fundfaq] [taenglish]
Conditions and duties [Standing rule]
Good academic standing, required exams and satisfactory teaching; first-year GPA ≤3.0 is not adequate under
current Math handbook. Preliminary exam by September of year two; qualifying exam by end of first quarter of
year three. Math TA duties average about 12 hours/week; university overall paid-work cap is 20 hours/week
and outside work requires approval. Fellows normally remain in residence. [handbook] [fundmodel]
Extra funding application [Unresolved]
No separate incoming support application found on Math checklist; confirm selection on portal. Later
fellowships and travel awards require separate applications or departmental nomination. Presidential
Fellowship is one departmental nominee from current years 2-5; not an incoming 2027 funding route. [math]
[presidential]
Other funding routes [Standing rule]
External fellowships are encouraged; disclose them because they replace institutional funding, with top-up
through year six when below the base. Mathematics may bank replacement quarters, maximum four. Later
Presidential Fellowship supplies up to 24 months stipend/tuition plus USD 1,000 annual research and up to USD
1,000 annual travel. Its 2027 existing-student nomination deadline is January 27, 5 p.m.; materials February 1,
11:59 p.m. (time zone not stated). [fundmodel] [handbook] [presidential]
Application fee [Standing rule]
USD 95, nonrefundable. Portal accepts Visa, Mastercard, Discover and American Express; debit card must carry
a supported card logo. [fee]
Fee waiver [Standing rule]
F-1 applicants are ineligible for the central citizenship/permanent-residency waiver route. Mathematics has a
VERY LIMITED international allocation: first upload academic statement, personal statement and unofficial
transcript, then email math-gradadm@northwestern.edu. Premature requests are rejected. Department
strongly recommends contact BEFORE October 31; as of November 5, remaining availability must be checked,
not presumed closed. No public final cutoff or turnaround is given. [math] [fee]
